market.question: Will the highest temperature in Kuala Lumpur be 32°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Kuala Lumpur May 8 forecast suggests highs around 92F (~33.3C). Most likely high integer is 33C, not 32C. Probability of exactly 32C is roughly 20-25% given typical 1-2C forecast uncertainty.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Convective rain could reduce daily high; forecast spread is ~2C.
